title: Silo Playback Protocol v3 Route Event
description: Request body of POST /api/v1/playback/route-event: one event object, not a batch. Bounds mirror validRouteEventV3 in internal/api/handlers/playback_v3.go. The endpoint is telemetry, so the server rejects a malformed event rather than half-recording it; every bound here is a rejection, and the two behaviours that are not rejections — unknown diagnostics keys being dropped, long diagnostics values being truncated — are described rather than constrained.

playback_attempt_id.description: The attempt this event belongs to, correlating every plan the client tried for one user-visible playback start.

plan_id.description: Echoed from the plan being reported on. Opaque to clients.

plan_attempt_key.description: Echoed from the plan being reported on. Opaque to clients: never computed on the client side.

event.description: The complete v3 telemetry contract. New names are added additively within v3; the server rejects a name it does not know, so a client must not invent one.

failure_classification.description: Neutral failure class, not a client-framework error string.

applied_quirk_ids.description: Quirks the client actually applied, so a registry entry can be measured against real outcomes rather than assumed to work.

diagnostics.description: Free-form key/value detail. The server keeps only keys on its allowlist and silently drops the rest, and trims each surviving value to 256 characters, so an unknown key or a long value is not a rejection — but more than 32 entries is.
